correctness.rationale: Two-step Ricker equations fix u,v uniquely; triangular full-map Jacobian gives exactly lambda_x=(1-u)(1-v), lambda_y=(s+beta h(u))(s+beta h(v)). Unique positive fixed point iff beta>beta_eq follows from strict monotonic nullclines. Strict concavity log q implies beta_eq<beta_cyc. Hyperbolic sink implies open strictly positive attracting basin; explicit small-amplitude expansion and rational witness are algebraically checked.

value.rationale: Gives a sharp nonempty and first-order quantified invasion/disappearance window in a biologically motivated Ricker model: existence of coexistence equilibrium at nominal carrying capacity differs from local invasion of the actual oscillating prey resident, with a full-dimensional extinction-attracting basin. An explicit rational witness and positive onset width make the effect testable and structurally meaningful.
